mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below its 12-month moving average compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional triggers.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month average, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals economic deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monetary easing (FEDFUNDS < 3.5%) and strong housing demand (HOUST > 1500) signal robust economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (FEDFUNDS < 3.5% and HOUST > 1500) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105) indicates robust supply chain capacity and corporate profitability, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 105, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales exceeding 750,000 million dollars (RSAFS > 750000) indicates strong consumer spending momentum, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS > 750000, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation (CPIAUCSL year-over-year > 5.0%) signals central bank tightening pressure, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly job growth exceeding 200,000 new positions (PAYEMS > 200000) indicates a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS > 200000, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth exceeding 2.0% (computed from GDPC1) signals robust economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 growth > 2.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
